newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Macraes more than doubles yr profit.
newsitem.headline: Macraes more than doubles yr profit.

text.p: Macraes Mining Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had made a record pre-tax profit NZ$23 million in the year to December, more than double the previous year's.
The result was substantially ahead of budget for the company, which operates the Macraes gold mine in Otago.
Gold production was 39,047 ounces in the December quarter, up 27 percent.
This boosted full 1996 gold production to a record 138,464 ounces, up 19 percent on 1995.
Cash costs of NZ$358 per ounce in the December quarter and NZ$402 for the full year were the lowest since production began in 1990.
With an extensive forward selling program locked in place, Macraes posted a December quarter cash operating margin of NZ$330/ounce and a full year's margin of NZ$299/ounce.
Chairman Brendan Fogarty said the mineral resources at the Macraes gold project had grown by almost 600,00 ounces in the last six months to end the year at a record 4.9 million ounces.
In the three years, Macraes has added 3.5 million ounces of gold to its resource reserve inventory through a major exploration programme costing NZ$20 million.
This represented an average discovery cost of NZ$5.70/ounce, one of the lowest discovery rates in the world.
Some of the best exploration results in the December quarter came from the Golden Bar prospect, where intersections included eight metres at 5.21 grammes/tonne (g/t) and 16 metres at 4.55g/t.
Further good drilling results were also reported from work in the Round Hill, Fraser and Innes Mills areas.
The Round Hill and Golden Point Resource estimate increased by 400,00 ounces or 46 percent to to 1.03 million ounces in the six months December 31.
The Frasers and Golden Ridge resource estimate rose by 13 percent to 2.37 million ounces.
Fogarty said some very good exploration results had also continued to come from the company's Reefton project on the West Coast of the South Island.
These included intersections of 12 metres at 13.37g/t and 19 metres at 10.98 g/t on the Globe Progress-Souvenir line of lode, further enhancing the development potential of the Reefton area.
Macraes is controlled by Perth-based Union Gold Mining NL.
Macraes gained 20 cents to NZ$3.10 on the news.
